name: Crypto 12-1 Month Momentum (Binance)
src: QuantGPT test on Binance USDT pairs; related: Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu (2022), Journal of Finance (1-4 week momentum)
thesis: Momentum is well documented in stocks, and Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu find it in coins at 1-4 week horizons. Does the slower 12-1 month version pay on Binance coins, judged against BTC?
criteria: Universe: Binance USDT pairs incl. delisted, $100k+ 30d average daily volume, 90d+ listed; stablecoins (listed or caught by a USD peg test), fiat pairs, tokenized gold and tokenized stocks excluded
Rank by 365-30 day return, long top 10 equal-weight, monthly; under 5 qualifiers means cash
Gross of fees, monthly returns capped at +300%; benchmark BTC buy-and-hold
result: Run it: the terminal computes the finding live against BTC.

name: Crypto Low Volatility
src: Low-risk anomaly (Ang, Hodrick, Xing and Zhang 2006; Baker, Bradley and Wurgler 2011), applied to Binance USDT pairs
thesis: In stocks, the calmest names have earned about as much as the wildest with far less risk. Do the 10 calmest liquid coins, stablecoins excluded, beat just holding BTC?
criteria: Universe: Binance USDT pairs incl. delisted, $100k+ 30d average daily volume, 90d+ listed
Exclude stablecoins (listed or caught by a USD peg test), fiat pairs, tokenized gold and tokenized stocks
Rank by 30d annualized volatility, long the LOWEST 10, monthly; benchmark BTC buy-and-hold
result: Run it: the terminal computes the finding live against BTC.

name: Crypto Trend + Strength
src: Trend following (Faber 2007; Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen 2012), applied to Binance USDT pairs
thesis: Only hold coins above their own 200-day average, ranked by 6-month strength: the classic trend filter plus relative strength, in USDT terms, judged against BTC.
criteria: Filter: price at or above its 200d SMA; under 5 qualifiers means cash
Rank by 180d return, long top 10 equal-weight, monthly rebalance
Gross of fees, monthly returns capped at +300%; benchmark BTC buy-and-hold
result: Run it: the terminal computes the finding live against BTC.

name: Prediction Market Longshots (Polymarket only)
src: Favorite-longshot bias (Griffith 1949; Snowberg and Wolfers 2010); resolved Polymarket markets, 2024-2026
thesis: Racetracks overprice longshots. Do prediction-market YES contracts at 2-15 cents resolve often enough to pay, or is the bias alive here too?
criteria: Buy YES (first listed outcome) at the last daily price on or before 7 days before resolution (the earlier of scheduled close and actual resolution), 2-15 cents only; markets already settled at 0 or 1 by then left out
Hold to resolution; 10% of bankroll per month split across that month's bets; no fees or spread
Benchmark: every resolved market priced 2-98 cents at entry, same timing and sizing
result: Run it: the terminal computes the finding live against the crowd. Polymarket only, about 200 bets: a small sample.

name: Prediction Market Favorites (Polymarket only)
src: Favorite-longshot bias (Griffith 1949; Snowberg and Wolfers 2010); resolved Polymarket markets, 2024-2026
thesis: The other side of the bias: at racetracks, favorites win slightly more often than their odds imply. Do prediction-market YES contracts at 60-98 cents do the same, by enough to survive fees?
criteria: Buy YES (first listed outcome) at the last daily price on or before 7 days before resolution (the earlier of scheduled close and actual resolution), 60-98 cents only; markets already settled at 0 or 1 by then left out
Hold to resolution; 10% of bankroll per month split across that month's bets; no fees or spread
Benchmark: every resolved market priced 2-98 cents at entry, same timing and sizing
result: Run it: the terminal computes the finding live against the crowd. Polymarket only, under 200 bets: a small sample.

name: Memecoin 30d Momentum, Graveyard Included
src: QuantGPT DEX-pool graveyard (GeckoTerminal; dead pools kept from collection start)
thesis: Does chasing last month's winners beat holding the whole pile of qualifying DEX tokens, once every death counts as a total loss?
criteria: Universe: Solana, Base and Ethereum pools with 30+ days of prices and $50k+ 30d average daily volume, dead ones included; majors, stablecoins and large DeFi tokens left out by symbol
Rank by 30-day return, long top 10 equal-weight, monthly; death = -100%, returns capped at +300%, gross of fees
Benchmark: the equal-weight pile of every pool that passed the same filter
result: Run it: the terminal computes the finding live against the pile.

name: Memecoin Survivors, 180 Days and Volume
src: QuantGPT DEX-pool graveyard (GeckoTerminal; dead pools kept from collection start)
thesis: Many memecoins die within weeks. Does holding only the pools that lived six months, ranked by volume, beat the pile?
criteria: Universe: pools with 180+ days of prices and $50k+ 30d average daily volume, dead ones included; majors, stablecoins and large DeFi tokens left out by symbol
Rank by 30-day average daily volume, long top 10 equal-weight, monthly; death = -100%, returns capped at +300%, gross
Benchmark: the equal-weight pile of every pool that passed the same filter
result: Run it: the terminal computes the finding live against the pile.

name: Follow the 24/7 Tape: Buy What It Bid Up Overnight
src: QuantGPT 24/7 tape (Hyperliquid xyz stock perps, hourly, from November 2025)
thesis: Hyperliquid's stock perps keep trading after NYSE closes. When the tape bids a stock up overnight or over the weekend, does the day keep going from the bell?
criteria: Universe: every US stock, ETF and index perp on Hyperliquid's xyz market with hourly prices
Each session, hold 09:00 New York to the close every name whose perp rose 0.5% or more since the prior close, equal weight
Benchmark: every name in the tape held 09:00 to the close
result: Run it: the terminal computes the finding live against every name.

name: Fade the 24/7 Tape: Buy What It Sold Off Overnight
src: QuantGPT 24/7 tape (Hyperliquid xyz stock perps, hourly, from November 2025)
thesis: If the overnight crowd overreacts, the names it sold off should recover once the real market opens. Do they?
criteria: Universe: every US stock, ETF and index perp on Hyperliquid's xyz market with hourly prices
Each session, hold 09:00 New York to the close every name whose perp fell 0.5% or more since the prior close, equal weight
Benchmark: every name in the tape held 09:00 to the close
result: Run it: the terminal computes the finding live against every name.
